description: List the user's bills (AP queue), ordered 'due-soon first' (dueDate ASC NULLS LAST, id DESC). Filter by `status[]` — defaults to `['PENDING']`. Cursor-paginated; pass `nextCursor` from the previous page back as `cursor` to advance. Each row carries the extracted merchant, total, currency, invoice number, and due date.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's `nextCursor`.

status.description: Filter by BillStatus. Default ['PENDING']. Pass multiple to include several states (e.g. ['PENDING','PAID']).

name: list_bills
